title: 天皇賞（秋）の後に・霹靂に刃向かいて

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: During the race, Mejiro Ardan surpasses her limits and seizes a spectacular victory. While exchanging compliments with Tamamo Cross and Oguri cap afterwards, she comes to a realization.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She has many rivals who will push her to run with every ounce of her being, and that as long as they exist, her potential for growth will remain limitless.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: This epiphany leaves her unable to contain her excitement for our next goal.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Around this time, Sakura Chiyono O watches the autumn Tenno Sho on TV and sees Mejiro Ardan's growth as a racer with her own eyes.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Mejiro Ardan begins her preparation for the Osaka Hai. She remains entirely oblivious, however, to the shadow now cast over Sakura Chiyono O's face…
